summary: Your board runs and matches the drawing almost point for point: the orange GROUT TRACKER header, the three batches in one list directly beneath it, and the add row with ADD BATCH to the right of the input. The one miss is the mix-ratio status line — your drawing puts it in orange under the add row, but the build has nothing there and drops straight to the footer. Persistence and CSV export I couldn't settle: they show nothing on screen and the passing test run I was handed names no check for either.
